title: ReGA: Representation-Guided Abstraction for Model-based Safeguarding of LLMs
reasoning: The paper focuses on a technical safeguarding framework called ReGA to detect harmful prompts and jailbreaking attacks in LLMs. While it mentions 'ethical guidelines' and 'human values' as part of the motivation for safety alignment, it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, spiritual traditions, or specific moral/ethical reasoning systems.
